Name: Clean Disk
Description: Remove ALL partitions from a disk, returning it to RAW/uninitialized state. EXTREME CAUTION: This erases everything on the disk!

Params.name: CleanInfo
Params.default:
[EXTREME DANGER] CLEAN DISK
This operation removes ALL PARTITIONS from the disk!
- ALL DATA ON THE ENTIRE DISK WILL BE LOST -
- This affects the ENTIRE disk, not just one partition
- Cannot be undone
- Disk will be returned to RAW/uninitialized state
- Use Initialize Disk after cleaning to prepare for new partitions
- ALWAYS use WhatIf mode first to verify!
- TRIPLE CHECK you have the correct disk selected!

Params.name: DiskNumber
Params.label: Select Disk
Params.description: - Select disk to clean - ALL DATA WILL BE LOST -

Params.name: ConfirmClean
Params.label: I understand all data will be lost
Params.description: You must check this box to acknowledge data loss
